name: Family Apartment Garden View
content: These Family Rooms with two separate areas offer comfortable accommodation with direct access to the resort’s landscaped gardens. Ideal for families or friends travelling together, the rooms feature a kitchenette, one bedroom with a double bed or two twin beds, a lounge area with additional beds, and a bathroom with a shower. Both rooms provide direct access to a terrace with outdoor furniture by the gardens, creating a pleasant space for relaxation. Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual room layout, design, and size may vary. Maximum Apartment Capacity: 5 Guests. Maximum adults: 4. Space 43 sq.m.
